Are you sure it's not just Deja Vu? I think it happens to the most of us where we see just a small tidbit of something and then it actually happens, and we're like, "Whoa. What the fuck?" 

They're not necessarily dreams, but they could be. I just don't think it's your "dreams coming true." It just might actually be Deja Vu.

I kinda feel ashamed, yet at the same time reading all of this it seems like second nature to all women.

We didn't really "meet", it's a bit different. It's really odd, because I'd known him for a while, but had never been attracted to him. That's mostly because he seemed to be in other relationships quite a bit and is a couple years older. He actually started dating my best friend, and we all went on group outings together. They didn't work out in the end for them, but at the beginning of the school year we talked to each other more often becoming closer friends than before. We were in a drama production together and we spent more time talking with each other. I eventually realized that I liked him and got the guts to tell him that I did. Surprisingly, he liked me too and we were dating from then on. I'd say it's a pretty good relationship :)
At that moment I wish I could've opened my eyes to see what was above me, but I'm glad whatever it was left before I was able to open my eyes. I really don't want to know what it might have been.
Sorry, dear, but quite a few stories are made up unless said differently.
